criteria.requirement: Protected routes must have server-side auth gating via middleware
criteria.evidence: src/middleware.ts exists (47 lines). Reads weshbazar_session cookie. Re-verified 2026-10-14.
criteria.acceptance: Middleware redirects unauthenticated requests to /auth/login

criteria.requirement: Admin UI must not render for non-admin users
criteria.evidence: Client-side role check: user.role === 'MODERATOR' || user.role === 'ADMIN'. Backend enforces. UI condition is informational.
criteria.remediation: Document that backend is the real authorization boundary
criteria.acceptance: Admin links hidden for USER role; backend rejects unauthorized API calls

criteria.requirement: Logout must clear all user-scoped caches and in-memory state
criteria.evidence: performLogout clears session cookie, access token, 7 query cache groups, then redirects to '/'
criteria.acceptance: No private data visible after logout

criteria.requirement: Refresh token cookie must not be sent on page requests
criteria.evidence: weshbazar_refresh cookie has path=/api/v1/auth. Page requests do not include it. weshbazar_session cookie is a separate indicator.
criteria.acceptance: Refresh cookie isolated to auth endpoints

criteria.requirement: All navigation links must point to existing pages
criteria.evidence: /categories link in bottom nav leads to 404. No src/app/categories/ directory.
criteria.verification: Filesystem check  browser test would confirm
criteria.remediation: Create /categories page or change link to /search
criteria.acceptance: All nav links resolve to valid pages

criteria.requirement: Category navigation must lead to category content
criteria.evidence: Grid3X3 icon button links to /search, not categories. Label says 'دسته‌بندی‌ها' but leads to search.
criteria.remediation: Change to /category page or relabel as search
criteria.acceptance: Category button navigates to actual category content

criteria.requirement: Header search must navigate to search results page
criteria.evidence: SearchField uses useQueryState('q') which writes q to current URL. On non-search pages, no results appear. redirectToSearch prop exists but is not passed from header.
criteria.remediation: Pass redirectToSearch={true} to SearchField in desktop header
criteria.acceptance: Search submission navigates to /search?q=...

criteria.requirement: Mobile header must provide search access
criteria.evidence: Mobile header has logo  auth only. No search input or entry point.
criteria.remediation: Add search icon button linking to /search
criteria.acceptance: Search accessible from mobile header

criteria.requirement: Logo must link to home page
criteria.evidence: BrandLogo wrapped in <Link href=\
> with aria-label in all three locations
criteria.acceptance: Logo click navigates to /

criteria.requirement: Sell CTA must navigate to /sell
criteria.applicability: Desktop and mobile headers, home page
criteria.evidence: All sell buttons link to /sell. Desktop header shows text 'ثبت آگهی', mobile shows icon on xs screens.
criteria.acceptance: Sell buttons navigate to /sell

criteria.requirement: Anonymous visitors see login/register links
criteria.evidence: HeaderAuthActions shows login button when status !== 'ready'. MobileBottomNav account tab links to /auth/login when not authenticated.
criteria.acceptance: Login entry visible for anonymous users

criteria.requirement: Authenticated users see account info and logout
criteria.evidence: When status === 'ready' && user, shows displayName link to /account, conditional admin link, and logout button.
criteria.acceptance: User info and logout visible when authenticated

criteria.requirement: Auth loading state shows appropriate indicator
criteria.evidence: Status 'checking' shows spinning Loader2 icon with aria-label.
criteria.acceptance: Loading indicator during auth check

criteria.requirement: Auth pages must preserve return navigation via next param
criteria.evidence: LoginForm receives `next` prop from searchParams. Register and verify pages pass `next` through query params.
criteria.acceptance: After login, user returns to intended page

criteria.requirement: Session expired produces predictable UI
criteria.evidence: 401 errors from bootstrapCurrentUser result in 'anonymous' status. Auth provider shows login link.
criteria.acceptance: Expired session treated as anonymous guest

criteria.requirement: Footer must include copyright with current year
criteria.evidence: Persian year via Intl.NumberFormat('fa-AF') renders correctly.
criteria.acceptance: Copyright year is correct and uses Persian digits

criteria.requirement: Footer must link to safety and help content
criteria.evidence: No safety/help/about/contact links in footer. Only marketplace and account link groups.
criteria.remediation: Add third link group with about, safety, help, contact links. Create target pages.
criteria.acceptance: Footer includes links to safety guidance and help content

criteria.requirement: Footer link destinations must be valid
criteria.evidence: All 7 footer links (/, /search, /sell, /auth/login, /favorites, /my-listings, /account) point to existing routes.
criteria.acceptance: All footer links resolve to valid pages

criteria.requirement: Footer must not invent contact details or social accounts
criteria.evidence: No phone numbers, emails, social links, or trust certifications invented.
criteria.acceptance: Footer contains only real, verified content

criteria.requirement: Skip-to-content link must be the first focusable element
criteria.evidence: <a href='#main' className='sr-only ...'> before header/nav.
criteria.acceptance: Skip link present and functional

criteria.requirement: All icon-only buttons must have accessible names
criteria.evidence: aria-label used on: category button, sell icon button (mobile), logout button, login button. Bottom nav icons have visible text labels.
criteria.acceptance: All icon buttons have accessible names

criteria.requirement: Focus-visible styles must be present on all interactive elements
criteria.evidence: Most interactive elements have focus-visible rings. LocationPicker dropdown option buttons lack focus-visible styles.
criteria.remediation: Add focus-visible:ring-2 to dropdown option buttons
criteria.acceptance: All interactive elements show visible focus indicators

criteria.requirement: RTL direction must be correctly applied
criteria.evidence: <html dir='rtl' lang='fa-AF'>. CSS logical properties used via bidi-isolate/bidi-ltr utilities.
criteria.acceptance: RTL layout and text direction correct

criteria.requirement: Fonts must self-host with display:swap
criteria.evidence: Vazir font loaded via next/font/local with display:'swap' and preload:true.
criteria.acceptance: No font FOUT, self-hosted

criteria.requirement: Header must not block page rendering
criteria.evidence: Headers are Server Components. Only HeaderAuthActions is a Client Component (narrow boundary).
criteria.acceptance: Headers render server-side, minimal client JS

criteria.requirement: Search input must be responsive (debounced/no blocking)
criteria.evidence: SearchField uses local state for typing, only commits to URL on submit. No debounce needed.
criteria.acceptance: Typing in search is instant, no API calls on keystroke

criteria.requirement: Brand colors must match Master Prompt V5 tokens
criteria.evidence: Primary #0F766E, primary-dark #0B2F2B, primary-soft #E6F5F3, accent #F59E0B, accent-dark #D97706, background #F8FAFC, border #E2E8F0.
criteria.acceptance: All brand colors match specification

criteria.requirement: Official logo assets must be used unchanged
criteria.evidence: BrandLogo uses official SVG from /public/brand/. No CSS approximations. Unoptimized SVG preserves vectors.
criteria.acceptance: Logos are official assets, not redrawn

criteria.requirement: Header, nav, footer, and auth must have test coverage
criteria.evidence: Zero tests for HeaderAuthActions, MobileBottomNav, SiteFooter, AuthProvider, DesktopHeader, MobileHeader.
criteria.file: No test files for layout/ or auth/
criteria.remediation: Add unit tests for all shared layout and auth components
criteria.acceptance: All shared components have passing tests
